{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Typho.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] wore a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] eye patch.]]

An '''eye patch''' was a small patch worn over an [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Some eye patches included a band that went around the head; others did not.
